results.title: How former Mariner Norm Charlton went from ‘The Sheriff’ to ‘captain’ - Fri, 07 Aug 2026 PST
results.description: Once one of the most feared left-handed relievers in baseball, today Charlton leads fishing and hunting expeditions from his home on the south Texas coast. He rises early and goes to bed late, whether running boats up the Rio Grande or out in the open waters of the sea.
